speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These symptoms suggest a systemic issue, possibly involving the lymphatic system or liver. Have you noticed any skin changes, such as yellowing (jaundice), or any recent fever spikes?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Advanced Gastric Adenocarcinoma with Hepatic and Supraclavicular Lymph Node Metastasis. The combination of significant weight loss, drenching night sweats, abdominal pain, and specifically the enlarged left supraclavicular lymph node (Virchow's node) strongly suggests a malignancy of gastrointestinal origin, likely the stomach or pancreas, spreading to the liver and lymphatic system. Given the severity and systemic nature of these findings, immediate biopsy and staging are required.
